about.paragraph1: I'm Akash Thirumal, currently working as a Digital Marketing and Visual Marketing Executive at SPT Hospitals in Coimbatore, with around 6–12 months of hands-on professional experience.
about.paragraph2: Rather than treating marketing numbers and visual craft as separate tracks, I work across both—planning paid campaigns, configuring conversion tracking, designing graphics, editing video content, and keeping websites and landing pages clear and effective.
